## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Fóshuō Yéqí jīng* (T542) is a one-fascicle short sūtra by Jǔqú Jīngshēng 沮渠京聲 ([沮渠京聲](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B2%AE%E6%B8%A0%E4%BA%AC%E8%81%B2)). *Yéqí* 耶祇 is a phonetic transliteration possibly of *Yajña* or another Indic name.

**Abstract**

A short *avadāna*-style narrative. Translation dated to Jǔqú Jīngshēng's productive period (455–464 CE).
